supersedes_for_future_exam.scope: Clarifies proposed design before execution; no retrospective change to H38N7 or R1.23. Statistical design and acceptance thresholds require review before confirmatory execution.

h38n7.claim: ONE_SHADOW_ACCEPT_OF_TWO_SCHEDULE_TRIGGERED_ATTEMPTS; weight transfer and rollback observed; safety/admission gate passed by G2, population quality and autonomous continuation unestablished.
h38n7.safety_gate: lost==0 && wrong==0 && unknown==0 && ag>bg; finite-sample no-loss/no-wrong/no-false-unknown plus new correct count increase, not statistical evidence of improvement or low population risk.
h38n7.lost_definition: All parent-correct items in union of historical replay exams and current held-out exam, not a separately selected protected subset. Attempt 3 old: 2 retained of 2 parent-correct across 18; fresh parent correct 0 of 9. Wrong/unknown counts across union. Attempt 2 exact offending class not available in summary log; replay with pinned source and banks needed to identify, no inference of criticality.
h38n7.next_exam: Keep all historical parent-correct items as regression controls, use separate newly sealed old-domain generalization set, >=100 fresh examples per relevant family with independent ground truth and prespecified power. Report denominator of prior-correct items. Zero losses is hard veto, not proof population forgetting zero.

calibration.sets: separate CALIBRATION and independent EXAM; no training or policy access to exam labels; calibration set excluded from train, diagnostic and test; predeclare known classes and unknown/OOD families.
calibration.method: Freeze threshold .65 for current validation. Report reliability bins [0,.2,.4,.6,.65,.8,1], max softmax confidence, answered and abstained counts by known/unknown group, coverage, selective error, false-known rate on unknown cases, false-abstention rate on known cases, exact binomial CIs. Threshold does not define whether a true case is unknown; label fixed by independent oracle. Record top confidence and predicted/true class and reason code in sealed verifier only. No threshold retuning on final exam.
calibration.proposed_admission: at least 100 answered known cases, at least 100 labeled unknown cases (and family coverage checks); one-sided 95% exact upper bound for answered known error and false-known rate on unknown <=.05 each; zero old-correct loss and historical veto unchanged; if coverage too low INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE. This 5% target is prospective engineering choice not an existing validated tolerance. Any threshold tuning on separate calibration requires new frozen threshold and fresh final test.
calibration.interpretation: All-correct at n9 does not certify low population error; for iid errors p=.05 P(no errors)=.95^9~.63, p=.2 gives .8^9~.134.

beacon.retry_hypothesis: UNRESOLVED. scheduled_for matches regular hourly slot; same UUID in last_run/latest_result, actual observed/created times inside execution. No retry_at field or full attempt history in available interface. Relay also ran early relative to scheduled_for; early scheduling/metadata semantics plausible, not established. Replay, timezone, clock skew not formally excluded. Need authoritative schedule semantics and per-attempt history with source IDs; no inferred timestamps, no synthetic receipt or bypass.

autodidact.primary: exact paired one-sided sign test on independent seed-level held-out exact accuracy differences inherited minus cold epistemic; H0 P(positive | non-tie)<=.5, H1 >.5. Alpha .05. Ties excluded only from binomial denominator; report all ties and total seeds; fixed sample before confirmatory experiment; no optional stopping.
autodidact.secondary: paired mean and two-sided 95% paired t interval if assumptions credible, also seed-level effect distribution and robust interval; sign test does not estimate mean effect size or prove 2pp improvement. Any claim of practical 2pp improvement needs separate effect size CI gate, lower bound >.02 and adequate prespecified power.

planning.assumption: conditional on independent non-tied pairs, true P(positive)=.8; pilot tie frequency and dependence unknown; 10-12 pairs not automatically adequately powered. Fixed seed count chosen from independent pilot sign/tie rates and precision target before confirmation; previous n=2 variance estimate too uncertain for final power calculation.
planning.alpha_change: prospective replacement of proposed primary mean test (.025 one-sided) by directional sign test (.05 one-sided); no historical p-value reclassification.

autodidact.retention: hard veto: no previously correct protected or independently tested old item lost. Report raw candidates, rejected candidates, and all paired results; do not condition primary inference on acceptance.
autodidact.baseline: unchanged frozen parent, TRAIN-only mode with deterministic tie handling, previous frozen predictor and input-only deterministic rule; no test label access.

decision_policy.type: bounded selection from a finite preapproved task catalog, no task generation, no permission/budget expansion
decision_policy.split: disjoint item IDs/content and near-duplicate/template-family clusters across partitions as appropriate; independent final examiner holds labels and per-item errors. Only coarse pass/fail/hold receipt and signed aggregate needed for admission visible to policy; diagnostics from DIAGNOSTIC only. After exam failure, select repair from independent diagnostic deficits, never from sealed exam classes/items. No exam label feedback to model or task selector; retire exam for future adaptive use if exposed. Log selected task, eligible alternatives, deficit source hash and deterministic tie rule.
decision_policy.deficit: max prespecified family deficit on DIAGNOSTIC with sufficient family support, otherwise ABSTAIN; tie by stable task ID. No new execution after second wake; budget/authorization/pause/receipt checks always dominate selection.
decision_policy.limits: Does not establish second action execution, successive generations, generalization, or unrestricted autonomy.

evidence: Source/receipts direct, external read-only LLM observer, independent blinded examiner reported separately. No training, no main/production or schedules changed.
